levelList.flavor:
The inevitable growing pains for those who are maturing в gods.

This sensation takes many forms: vertigo, nausea, seizure, self-deception... и to some, refusal. To them, the world is full of terror и alienating chaos. To endure the nausea, to protect those that are yet their own и those that are yet to become superfluous, the nascent god vomits.

levelList.name: Le Trou Rouge
levelList.desc: [StartBattle] Получает +4 счётчика [ChargeRouge]
levelList.flavor:
This is a crimson hollow.
Though it is closed, the endless hunger lingers, desiring the impossible satiation.

For that is what the others expect this being to be. For that is the purpose for which this being was born.
